PreInvocation.command: command -v te-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec te-hook --host antigravity --event PreInvocation || exec bash ./tools/te.sh hook --host antigravity --event PreInvocation

Stop.command: command -v te-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec te-hook --host antigravity --event Stop || exec bash ./tools/te.sh hook --host antigravity --event Stop
